title: It is a lot longer than advertised. It is ok but not best quality.
text: It is a lot longer than advertised. It is ok but not best quality.. It is a lot bigger than shown in here and it actually has 4! NOT 3, rectangles at the top of the lid which actually makes it a lot longer than advertised here. It did not help for what I needed it for and I was hoping for something slightly smaller and thinner as well. The handles are not the best and seem to be bad quality. It would probably be more useful if I had more space for it but since I do not it is really a nuisance in my house. I should have measured before buying.

Perfect for the bedroom, office, garage, hefty home storage solutions and storage bins are ideal for any room you need to stack smart and save space.
